item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Uses a predictor-specific `feedback_fn` returning `dspy.Prediction(score=0.1, feedback=...)`, matching GEPA's score+feedback predictor-feedback path."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Builds `eval_batch.trajectories` with two examples for one predictor, each including `example`, `prediction`, module `score`, and a matching one-step predictor trace."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Asserts the feedback objects' scores become `[0.9, 0.9]`, demonstrating predictor-level `0.1` is overwritten by the module score for both examples."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Captures `dspy.teleprompt.gepa.gepa_utils` logger output and asserts the mismatch warning substring appears exactly once across both mismatches."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Checks `dataset[\"predictor\"][0][\"Feedback\"]` and `[1][\"Feedback\"]`, confirming predictor-specific feedback text is preserved in both reflective rows."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
